skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Gorgeous Flower
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Gorgeous Flower. Flint's attire when she set out on a lone journey, a 'Catastrophe Messenger' by her own declaration. Before, her fists only knew Acahualla and Rhodes Island. Now, it's Terra's turn.
skins.usage: One of Flint's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'Been learning for so long. Now I can finally go take on all those strong guys. Yeah, relax. I'll be a little civilized about it.'
